fields.rationale: Core sharding, configuration, resilience, and expression-tree compilation are provider-agnostic, while ADO.NET drivers and native type systems are provider-specific. Binding each model class to a single provider avoids runtime provider-dispatch ambiguity and preserves first-class support for provider-native types and bulk primitives.
fields.statement: Concentrate the framework's logic in a shared core and expose it through thin, provider-specific packages (ArgentSea.Sql for SQL Server, ArgentSea.Pg for PostgreSQL). Support each provider fully on its own terms and keep dependencies minimal; a single model class targets exactly one provider, not several at once.
fields.title: One shared core, thin provider-specific packages

sources.label: Setup — shared package, two provider namespaces, minimal dependencies, one provider per model
